name: Production Raw Material Tracker
query:
SELECT
    woi.operation AS "Operation",
    woi.item_code AS "Item Code",
    NULL as "Remarks",
    (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sed.serial_no SEPARATOR ', ')
        FROM `tabStock Entry Detail` sed
        JOIN `tabStock Entry` ste ON sed.parent = ste.name
        WHERE ste.work_order = w.name
          AND sed.item_code = woi.item_code
          AND sed.serial_no IS NOT NULL
    ) AS "Serial No",
    woi.required_qty AS "Required Quantity",
    woi.transferred_qty AS "Transferred Quantity",
    (
        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sed.s_warehouse SEPARATOR ', ')
        FROM `tabStock Entry Detail` sed
        JOIN `tabStock Entry` ste ON sed.parent = ste.name
        WHERE ste.work_order = w.name
          AND sed.item_code = woi.item_code
          AND ste.purpose = 'Material Transfer for Manufacture'
    ) AS "Transferred From Warehouse",
    woi.consumed_qty AS "Consumed Quantity",
    (woi.transferred_qty - woi.consumed_qty) AS "Excess",
    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY woi.operation ORDER BY w.idx) = 1 
        THEN w.production_item 
    END AS "production_item",
    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY woi.operation ORDER BY w.idx) = 1 
        THEN (
            SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sed.serial_no SEPARATOR ', ')
            FROM `tabStock Entry Detail` sed
            JOIN `tabStock Entry` ste ON sed.parent = ste.name
            WHERE ste.work_order = w.name
              AND sed.item_code = w.production_item
              AND sed.serial_no IS NOT NULL
        )
    END AS "pserial",
    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY woi.operation ORDER BY w.idx) = 1 
        THEN w.qty 
    END AS "qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY woi.operation ORDER BY w.idx) = 1 
        THEN w.produced_qty 
    END AS "produced_qty"
FROM `tabWork Order Item` AS woi
JOIN `tabWork Order` AS w ON woi.parent = w.name
WHERE w.production_plan = %(production_plan)s

UNION ALL


SELECT
    CONCAT(wo.operation, ' - Additional') AS "Operation",  
    sed.item_code AS "Item Code",
    (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mr_item.remarks SEPARATOR ', ')
    FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
    JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mr_item ON mr_item.parent = mr.name
    WHERE mr.production_plan = wo.production_plan
      AND mr_item.item_code = sed.item_code
      AND mr.material_request_type = 'Material Transfer'
      AND mr.docstatus = 1
    ) AS "Remarks",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sed.serial_no SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Serial No",
    (
        SELECT IFNULL(SUM(mr_item.qty), 0)
        FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
        JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mr_item ON mr_item.parent = mr.name
        WHERE mr.production_plan = wo.production_plan
          AND mr_item.item_code = sed.item_code
          AND mr.material_request_type = 'Material Transfer'
          AND mr.docstatus = 1
    ) AS "Required Quantity",
    SUM(sed.qty) AS "Transferred Quantity",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sed.s_warehouse SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Transferred From Warehouse",
    (
        SELECT IFNULL(SUM(si.qty), 0)
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` si ON si.parent = se.name
        WHERE se.work_order = ste.work_order
          AND se.purpose = 'Manufacture'
          AND se.docstatus = 1
          AND si.item_code = sed.item_code
    ) AS "Consumed Quantity",
    SUM(sed.qty) - (
        SELECT IFNULL(SUM(si.qty), 0)
        FROM `tabStock Entry` se
        JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` si ON si.parent = se.name
        WHERE se.work_order = ste.work_order
          AND se.purpose = 'Manufacture'
          AND se.docstatus = 1
          AND si.item_code = sed.item_code
    ) AS "Excess",
    NULL AS "production_item",
    NULL AS "pserial",
    NULL AS "qty",
    NULL AS "produced_qty"
FROM `tabStock Entry Detail` sed
JOIN `tabStock Entry` ste ON sed.parent = ste.name
JOIN `tabWork Order` wo ON wo.name = ste.work_order
LEFT JOIN `tabWork Order Item` woi 
    ON woi.parent = ste.work_order 
    AND woi.item_code = sed.item_code
WHERE ste.work_order IN (
    SELECT name FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE production_plan = %(production_plan)s
)
AND woi.item_code IS NULL
AND ste.purpose = 'Material Transfer for Manufacture'
AND ste.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY sed.item_code, wo.operation
ORDER BY 
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(`Operation`, ' - Additional', 1) ASC,
    CASE WHEN `Operation` LIKE '%%- Additional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
    `Item Code` ASC;
